contract: Two actual simulated separately noisy acquisitions A one-way + B interleaved, 400 MHz, same loaded q8 nominal hardware, total 2 W available across 16 transmit shots; retain each independent 64-channel hard radius. A/B share physical operator and repeated source responses are evaluated only once.
warm_starts: For each constrained family, its old A candidate and its sealed B-refitted material. Unrestricted receives the best original A candidate and best B-refitted map ranked by joint loss under the same original wave solves. All have box [0,4.5].
optimizer: Exact-wave measurement-space active-set Levenberg-Gauss-Newton with a projected box step and original-wave backtracking. Identical accepted update and major-iteration cap across families.
strict_replay: Validate first lexicographic successful joint record for each family if any; use saved exact discrete data/operators and interval-backed original Fourier action.
interpretation: Successful endpoint is a joint whole-wave existence witness; no numerical miss proves global incompatibility. The unrestricted fit checks whether the budget can find any joint physical explanation.
